name: interior_rooms
description: Furnished-room templates (房间陈设模板): pick a `room`, give the interior rect (width x depth), origin and door position(s); the generator fills it with a canonical furniture set per room type — bedroom(床+床头柜+衣柜/抽屉柜+落地灯), kitchen(厨台[水槽+台面+炉灶]+橱柜), living(沙发+茶几+书架+壁炉或落地灯), dining(长桌+对坐餐椅+落地灯), study(书桌+书架+落地灯), corridor(落地灯+盆栽点缀). All pieces come from patterns/furniture.py (same recipes, direction states derived). The generator itself enforces wall-flush placement, no overlaps, door cells clear, and a connected >=1-wide walkway from every door to every piece's front — the AI never free-styles placement.
when_to_use: Interior furnishing AFTER walls/floor/ceiling exist — replaces free-hand furniture placement (which historically produced empty shells or unenterable rooms). origin = the room's min-corner INTERIOR cell, y = the layer furniture stands in (one above the floor blocks). The interior rect is [0..width-1] x [0..depth-1]; walls sit OUTSIDE it. doors = one entry per doorway: {"wall": "north|south|east|west", "at": offset along that wall from the room min corner}; empty = auto (south-centre door; corridor gets two end doors). Room too small / piece fits nowhere -> hard error with the legal minimum; enlarge or move the door. Layout rationale and room-division rules: patterns/interior_layout.md.
use_for: 室内布局/软装成套布置:卧室/厨房/客厅/餐厅/书房/走廊;修内饰时按房间逐个调用,不要逐件自由摆放

origin.notes: 室内最小角(西北角)的家具站立格;y = 地板上面那一层

width.notes: 室内净宽(沿 x,不含墙厚)

depth.notes: 室内净深(沿 z,不含墙厚)

doors.notes: 每个门洞一条:wall=所在墙, at=沿墙偏移(北/南墙沿 x,东/西墙沿 z,从房间最小角数);门内侧一格永不放家具

fireplace.notes: living:true=壁炉(烟囱道 chimney=0,穿出屋顶请接 chimney 卡);false=落地灯

wood.notes: 沙发/厨台/书桌的楼梯木种(spruce/dark_oak/oak...)

bedroom.set: bed(床头贴墙,真床方块) + table 1x1 当床头柜(贴床头侧) + storage(2宽3高抽屉柜/衣柜,贴侧墙) + lamp_post(远角,可选)
pitfalls: 床两侧+床尾至少留出一条 1 宽通道(生成器保证床尾与脚侧可达),别把床三面封死只留床头
床头柜是 1x1 table(fence+pressure_plate),就贴床头那格;别放成第二张床

kitchen.set: kitchen_counter(cauldron 水槽+倒放楼梯台面+smoker 炉灶,长 2-4 贴主墙) + cabinet 2x2(贴侧墙/对墙)
pitfalls: 台面正面(人站的那排)必须留空——生成器已校验;别把橱柜再压到台面前
smoker 才是灶,别换 furnace;水槽就是空 cauldron,别倒水(会烫脚且漫不出)

living.set: sofa(2-4 座贴主墙) + table 茶几(沙发前两格,可选) + bookshelf 2x2(侧墙) + fireplace 或 lamp_post(沙发对墙)
pitfalls: 壁炉正面 1 格是烤火位,必须留空;沙发与壁炉之间至少留 1 行走道
fireplace=true 时烟囱道只到壁炉顶(chimney=0);要继续穿屋顶用 chimney 卡接上,别在室内凭空叠柱

dining.set: table 长桌(宽 2-4,居中) + chair 对坐两排(桌宽>=3 时每侧 2 把,否则 1 把) + lamp_post(角,可选)
pitfalls: 餐椅从椅子背后入座(椅背后是通道),椅面正对桌子;别把椅子放成背对桌子
椅子含扶手 sign 实际占 3 格宽,两把椅子之间至少隔 1 格——生成器按桌宽自动减椅数

study.set: desk(2-3 宽贴主墙,带 lectern) + bookshelf 2x3(侧墙/对墙) + lamp_post(角,可选)
pitfalls: 书桌正面留空坐人;书架别挡在书桌正前方
bookshelf 不是 chiseled_bookshelf(空格纹理像烂柜)

corridor.min_size: 1x3(净宽<2 或长<4 时不出家具,只留空廊——见 interior_layout.md)
corridor.set: lamp_post(长边一侧 1/3 处) + flower_pot pedestal(对侧 2/3 处,可选)
pitfalls: 净宽 1 的走廊什么都别放——一格灯柱就断路;要装饰就放宽到 2
灯与点缀必须错开两侧/错位摆放,同格对放会把 2 宽走廊掐成 0
先跑本卡再补散件:本卡保证通道成网,之后手加的散件(地毯/盆栽)也必须跑 collision_check + support_check 复验
width/depth 是室内净尺寸(不含墙厚)——把外墙外尺寸填进来家具会嵌进墙里
doors 的 at 是沿墙偏移不是世界坐标;填错墙/偏移,家具可能堵住真实门洞(生成器只保你声明的门)
床必须用真床方块(part=foot/head 两格)——项目耻辱柱错误,严禁羊毛冒充
所有朝向状态由 furniture.py 从 origin+facing 推导,禁止手改输出 JSON 里的 facing/half/rotation/part
房间小于 min_size 会直接报错——去 interior_layout.md 查最小开间,先改房间划分再来陈设
家具都在 y+0/y+1 落地;天花板吊灯不在本卡范围(用 chain+lantern 自己挂,见 interior_layout.md)
example: python patterns/interior_rooms.py --params '{"room":"bedroom","origin":[100,65,100],"width":5,"depth":5,"doors":[{"wall":"south","at":2}]}' --out bedroom.json && python patterns/interior_rooms.py --params '{"room":"living","origin":[100,65,120],"width":6,"depth":6,"fireplace":true}' --out living.json && python patterns/validators/collision_check.py --params '{"a":"walls.json","b":"bedroom.json"}'
